children: ADMISSION OF FURTHER SHARES TO TRADING

IMI plc (the "Company") announces, in accordance with the Financial Conduct Authority's Prospectus Rules: Admission to Trading on a Regulated Market (PRM) sourcebook 1.6.4R, that the following shares have been admitted to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange pursuant to their allotment under the Company's Sharesave Scheme (SAYE).
Details of the transferable securities admitted to trading
Name, type and ISIN of the securities
Number of further securities admitted to trading covered by this notification
Total number of securities admitted to trading following further issuance
Fully fungible with existing ordinary shares
Date of issuance and admission to trading
Issued on various dates between 21 January 2026 and 26 August 2026.
